item.title: ISSUES OF FAITH: One Creative Force
item.description: THE WATCHWORD OF Judaism, Shema Israel Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad, means “Hear O Israel the Lord our God, the Lord is One.” Rabbi Lawrence Kushner elaborates on this when he says: “And the last secret is that everything is One …. At night when you lie down, In the morning when you get up, when you go for a walk, when you stay home, the whisper is always the same — “The Lord is One,” (Honey From the Rock).
